title: Transcendent Kingdom
author: Yaa Gyasi
summary: Gifi is a Ghanaian-American neuroscientist studying addiction and depression in mice. She is also trying to make sense of her brother's overdose, her mother's depression and the faith she grew up with.
readIf: you like introspective novels where science, grief, faith and immigrant family life meet.
skipIf: you want an upbeat read or are unsettled by close portraits of addiction and depression.
